svt_mipi_dsi_monitor Class Reference

Inheritance diagram for class svt_mipi_dsi_monitor:

List of all members.

Detailed Description

This class implements MIPI DSI Monitor component. It is used to monitor signals on the interface. Check the packets transmitted from the Host and Device side and put into scorebaord to compare those packets. Also, performs checks on those packets to check errors in packet field.

Monitor can be used in active and passive mode. In active mode, Monitor can be disable using the configuration. But, in passive mode, Monitor shall always enable.

Analysis port is given for users to get packets out of the Monitor.
